prediction: yhat(w) = K a + ybar + epoch_harm(w);  K=exp(-gamma*mean_phase_sq_hellinger); gamma=gamma_factor/median(train d2)

epoch_harm.form: H(w) = amp(B,d) * sum_g b_g * sum_{j in g} max(e0_j - tau_g, 0);  e0_j = w0_j * f0 * B / T_j  (phase-0 epochs)
epoch_harm.note: Additive bpb guardrail, ALWAYS applied. Self-gating at the real training budget: identically 0 over the entire in-support swarm for budgets 1e10..1e12 (so it never perturbs in-distribution ranking, OOF Spearman held at 0.938), and fires only for genuine over-repetition (high weight on a small bucket). Amplitude decays as B^-0.73, so it is dormant at >=100B and strongest at the 10B calibration budget. tau/b read verbatim from the campaign's dedicated epoch experiments; validated against humaneval in epoch_kernel_headtohead.
